entries.name: Cackletta, the Beanbean Witch
entries.look: Cackletta — The Witch Who Refused to Stay Dead Cackletta was supposed to be finished. The Beanbean Kingdom Crisis of 1012 BF ended with her defeat at the hands of Mario and Luigi—the brothers working as genuine partners for the first time, their combined abilities destroying a witch whose individual power exceeded either of them alone. Her body was destroyed. Her spirit was dispersed. Her plans for the Beanstar were undone. Fawful escaped. History moved on. entries.name: Fawful, the Fury
entries.look: Fawful — The Assistant Who Became the Architect Fawful is the most dangerous individual currently operating in the Mushroom Kingdom's sphere of influence who is not a god, a dimensional anomaly, or a force of nature. He is a small Beanish man with enormous glasses, speech patterns that weaponize grammar into incomprehensibility, and a mind that processes strategic complexity the way other minds process breathing—automatically, constantly, without conscious effort, producing results that make brilliant analysts feel stupid and careful planners feel careless. entries.name: Midbus, the Blizzard Fist
entries.look: Midbus — Fawful's Fist, Bowser's Replacement Midbus is the creature Fawful built to be Bowser's opposite. Where Bowser is fire, Midbus is ice. Where Bowser is prideful rage, Midbus is cold obedience. Where Bowser fights for his own glory, Midbus fights because Fawful tells him to fight. He is a massive pig-beast of uncertain origin—part mechanical, part organic, part something that Fawful's engineering produced through processes that conventional biology finds objectionable—and he serves as Fawful's primary enforcer, bodyguard, and blunt instrument for situations that require something larger
